about.disclaimer: Academic prototype. This application provides no diagnostic value and does not replace the judgment of a radiologist or physician under any circumstances.
about.overview_text: This project classifies chest X-rays into four categories (COVID-19, lung opacity, viral pneumonia, normal) using a convolutional neural network, with Grad-CAM attention maps for explainability and automatic structured report generation.
limitations: The model classifies the whole image; it does not reliably localize any abnormality (Grad-CAM shows an attention area, not a clinical localization).
Lower recall on the COVID-19 class (~77%) — see the README for the per-class breakdown.
Imbalanced dataset, not clinically validated by a radiologist.
